burned.reason: Published as a partial source-forge release on 2026-07-04 and downloadable for weeks, then deleted as never-delivered: it reached no package index and no managed channel. The bytes may be held by anyone who fetched them, so the number can never be minted again.

Published as a partial source-forge release on 2026-07-21 carrying eight assets including a 177 MB host-extension bundle, downloadable for weeks, then deleted as never-delivered. A second, different build was later stamped with the same version, which is the collision that prompted the ledger.
